summary: Full forensic PYQ analysis for Manufacturing Technology (BE05000311) mid-sem exam. Maps 142 questions from 9 old papers (Winter 2022-2025, Summer 2022-2026) against the new 3-chapter syllabus. Tags every PYQ question as IN/OUT/BORDERLINE. Builds topic frequency tables with Tier 1/2/3 classification. Identifies Danger Zones (resistance welding, forging, sheet metal, plastics, super finishing — all OUT despite high PYQ frequency). Provides two study strategies: Strategy A (20/30 marks, ~6.5 hrs) and Strategy B (25/30 marks, ~12.5 hrs). Includes key formulas, mark distribution prediction, and priority matrix.
